In Germany, a swan fell in love with a boat.
In two thousand six, a black swan named Petra spotted a giant white swan pedal boat on a lake in Munster.
She followed it across the lake, and defended it from anyone who came close.
When winter came, the city didn't separate them.
They moved Petra and her boat to the zoo, together.
Everyone wants someone to be close to.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny is always close by.
